# computesphere_team (Data Source)

Provides details for a single team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    computesphere = {
      source  = "computesphere/computesphere"
      version = "~> 1.1"
    }
  }
}

variable "api_token" {
  description = "API token for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "account_id" {
  description = "Account ID for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
}

variable "api_url" {
  description = "API URL for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
  default     = "api.computesphere.com"
}

provider "computesphere" {
  api_token  = var.api_token  # or set COMPUTESPHERE_API_TOKEN env variable
  account_id = var.account_id # or set COMPUTESPHERE_ACCOUNT_ID env variable
  api_url    = var.api_url    # or set COMPUTESPHERE_API_URL env variable
}

data "computesphere_team" "default" {
  id = "b7e6a1c2-3f4d-4e5a-8b9c-1d2e3f4a5b6c"
}

data "computesphere_team" "with_account" {
  id         = "b7e6a1c2-3f4d-4e5a-8b9c-1d2e3f4a5b6c"
  account_id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the team.

### Optional

- `account_id` (String) The ComputeSphere account ID. Defaults to the provider account_id if not set.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp of the team.
- `description` (String) Description of the team.
- `name` (String) Name of the team.
- `updated_at` (String) Last updated timestamp of the team.
